title: The flow fixes: Isao in every seat, SECURE ends the sector, one close-up gate, sector 0's seat on the sinkhole, and three dead-time defaults
context: docs/FLOW.md (the audit of the same night) ranked eleven problems in the flow of stages. The owner: "there is nothing to do until the Stalheart is built, that does not work"; "first we want the flow of stages" (difficulty later). Branch flow-fixes off 977de6b2, worked while the owner slept: each bug reproduced with the --flow probe first (FLOW PROBE: the bodies alive at SECURE, sector 0's aim and blast), then fixed and run again.
outcome: Fixed, each reproduced with --flow first: (1) a seat hid #td-brief while the queue spent the lines (base: alien_comms, harvest_biomass, wave_cleared, first_harvest, no_bank, biomass_bonds, biomass_seeps, quiver_cleared said hidden); a compact caption in every seat now, 0 hidden, the economy lines on screen at 70-88 s. (2) SECURE came with 90 hostile bodies alive in sector 6 (sourceless walkers, the stall rule) and 62 in sector 7, one hop from the heart; the debrief waited 123 s and sector 7 was LOST 17 s after SECURE. At SECURE the field is stood down (harmless) and the debrief follows within securePause + secureHold; after: every SECURE of sectors 1-7 to its debrief in 2.8-3.0 s, no loss. (3) One close-up gate (src/domain/closeup-gate.js) for the antenna, the companion prints and the FEIDS-26 drop: not over a shot, a weapon seat or a live wave (a print's patience no longer overrides). (4) THE KING's seat footer and ARENA_HANDOVER said paint-then-release; they say mark, 8 s. (5) sentry_overload_01 (ten auto-sentries) retired via VOICE_RETIRED. (6) Sector 0's seat opened straight down, 4.1 cells off the heart and 25.5 off the sinkhole; the MK-9 there sealed nothing (no friendly hurt: a strike never touches the hull or Isao). It opens on the lane's cell now: aim 1.4 cells off, MK-9 0.9 off, sealed. Defaults (DECISIONS, the owner's): the depot at rotor-ready and a live shot of the rover's first run (clear to card 34 s, was 55; --dog-scout 48 -> 24 s); Isao's construction_ram after TANK IS READY (sector 0 79 s, was 100); sector 1's grace held while the hull is out past where it stood or a shot/screen/pause holds the game, cap 240 s (study to sector 1 114 s, C-07's 15 s close-up no longer counted). The harness defender now culls bodies that never rose from a breach; with it one page plays from the landing through sector 7 (sectors 3, 4, 5 reached and secured); the sector 6 jump reaches THE ARENA. Not built: the first orders' unbought cards (a recommendation in DECISIONS).
alternatives: SECURE only when the field is clear: rejected for now, the stall rule (20 s without progress) would then need a new end, and the owner allowed stragglers on 2026-10-16; standing them down keeps both.
Holding Isao's lines until a seat is left: rejected, the Rotor's seat lasts the whole first wave and the economy lines would come after the harvest they explain; a caption reads in the seat.
Three special cases for the antenna, the prints and the drop: rejected for one pure rule (src/domain/closeup-gate.js).

Counting sector 1's grace only while the story is ready (no line on Isao's panel): built, measured (sector 1 at the 240 s cap, 249 s after the study), replaced the same night by holding it only under a shot, a screen, a pause or the errand.
evidence: Base re-run (977de6b2 + probe 8518b403, snapshot): --flow FROM=open TO=3 and FROM=6; FLOW PROBE secure census sector 6 {hostile 90, emerging 90 (no breach source)}, sector 7 {hostile 62, minHops 1, heart 3.7}, LOST at 618.5 s.
After (29d02b01..0d3a2ec0, snapshots): --flow FROM=open TO=99 (wall cap at sector 7), FROM=6 TO=99 (to THE ARENA), two FROM=open re-runs; no page error.
--dog-scout, --king, --chapters, --grow, --skip-tutorial, --story-world: passed (story-world's Rotor sentry-control steps green: 27 rounds, 10 hits).

npm test (348 programs) and npm run check green at the final commit; test/closeup-gate.mjs, test/sectors.mjs (standDown, secureDone, firstSectorDue cap), test/voice-hooks.mjs (40 rolls, never the ten take), test/boss-run.mjs (no paint/release in the fight's words).
